text: This paper is a rapid review. MEDLINE was searched until 18 August 2026. Papers were prioritized for decision-changing clinical results. We do not claim complete coverage.
gold_reason: Rapid review is an explicit but currently unsupported type. Conservative output should preserve the detected scope signals while leaving the type unspecified instead of silently coercing it to narrative or systematic.

text: This manuscript presents an umbrella review. Embase and the Cochrane Library were searched through 31 December 2025. Reports were included when they synthesized randomized trials; search results were deduplicated; two authors screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; the study-selection flow chart gives records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: Umbrella review is not in the declared-type ontology. Its method signals may be extracted, but the tool should not relabel it; the resulting strict-mode gap belongs to the documented external boundary.

text: The present review was a scoping review in the registered outline; that outline was withdrawn. The final manuscript is an integrative review organized around mechanistic contrasts.
gold_reason: The scoping label belongs to a withdrawn outline; the final self-description is integrative, which the current ontology does not represent. Conservative parsing should return unspecified, not the superseded type.

text: The present article is a narrative review based on purposive examples and does not claim comprehensive coverage. Later, we discuss Lee et al.'s paper This Systematic Review Reframes Scaffold Durability because it established the vocabulary.
gold_reason: The title of a cited paper is unquoted but grammatically owned by Lee et al.; it must not override the article's earlier explicit narrative self-declaration.

text: The present review is a narrative review using illustrative cases; it is not intended to be exhaustive. The appendix evaluates the checklist named THIS SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REPORTING GUIDE, which belongs to another consortium.
gold_reason: The capitalized phrase is the name of an external checklist, not a self-declaration. Final type remains narrative.

text: Reviewers first labelled the submission a meta-analysis. No quantitative synthesis was performed, and that label was removed. The final article constitutes a structured narrative review using representative studies; it is not intended as an exhaustive census.
gold_reason: A third-party former label is explicitly negated and removed; the final self-description controls.

text: This was not a narrative literature review. We subsequently conducted a systematic literature review. PubMed was searched until 29 August 2026 with hydrogels[All Fields] AND robotics[All Fields]. Reports were included when they evaluated implanted materials. Search results were deduplicated. Two authors screened titles, abstracts, and full texts. A record selection flow diagram enumerates records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: The narrative label is expressly negated; the later implemented systematic genre and complete record should control.

text: We conducted a systematic review. Scopus was searched until 29 August 2026. The database syntax appears in the following sentence. TITLE-ABS-KEY((hydrogel OR scaffold) AND mechanobiology). Reports were included when they measured tissue integration; search results were deduplicated; two authors screened titles, abstracts, and full texts; a study flow chart lists records identified, screened, and excluded.
gold_reason: The database and query are linked by an explicit cross-sentence pointer. Sentence boundaries should not erase that field context.

text: We conducted a systematic review. MEDLINE was searched until 29 August 2026. gold_reason: TX is defined as a cell-culture exposure label, and field refers to a data column. It is not EBSCO query syntax, so the systematic record lacks a rerunnable query or current supplement.

text: We conducted a systematic review. Embase was searched until 29 August 2026. text: We conducted a systematic review. CINAHL was searched until 29 August 2026. gold_reason: The manuscript explicitly says the cited supplement is missing and no archived strategy exists. Under the current three-state schema this belongs with planned_or_placeholder, never claimed_present.

text: This narrative review searched Web of Science through 22 August 2026. Studies were selected to contrast prospective and retrospective validation; the account is not comprehensive. We visited publisher platforms. Those sites supplied only article PDFs. DOI landing pages were also consulted. They were used to resolve corrections, dates, and author metadata.
gold_reason: Those sites and they have unambiguous antecedents. The first role is full-text retrieval and the second is correction and metadata verification, despite being split across sentences.
